item.title: Hashcards: A Plain-Text Spaced Repetition System
item.description:
📝 You write flashcards more or less like you’d write ordinary notes, with lightweight markup to denote basic (question/answer) flashcards and cloze deletion flashcards. item.title: The Typeframe PX-88 Portable Computing System
item.description:
📝 The PX-88 delivers all the power and specialized features expected from a professional system - but built around a dedicated, uncompromising user experience. A mechanical keyboard provides a superior, tactile input experience - a professional tool unmatched by common consumer electronics. If you have been looking for a portable, professional computer where input quality meets core performance, look at the PX-88.
🔗 Read more: https://www.typeframe.net/

item.title: Update Now: iOS 26.2 Fixes 20 Security Vulnerabilities, 2 Actively Exploited
item.description:
📝 Apple says that the updates address over 20 vulnerabilities, including two bugs that are known to have been actively exploited. Apple says that the bugs might have been exploited in an attack against targeted individuals on versions of iOS before iOS 26. Now that these vulnerabilities have been publicized by Apple, even those that were not exploited before might be taken advantage of now.
🔗 Read more: https://www.macrumors.com/2025/12/12/ios-26-2-security-vulnerabilities/
